entities.title: Online play in lockstep
entities.summary: Every browser runs the whole match and exchanges only controls.
entities.context: Two players on different connections must see the same match, and the engine is already deterministic for replays.

options.title: Lockstep in every browser
options.consequences: Only controls cross the network; a slow player makes the other wait.

options.title: A server runs the match
options.consequences: The server needs the engine, a clock and state per match.

entities.decision: Lockstep: controls are scheduled a few steps ahead, and a browser steps only with every player's controls; fingerprints are compared every 120 steps.
entities.rationale: The same property that lets the server replay a match keeps the browsers in step, and the relay only passes messages on.

entities.title: One name for every game
entities.summary: The table name follows Samosa's rules and is shared for the browser session.
entities.context: A player who enters one game's table should not have to type their name again in another.
entities.decision: src/name.ts has the same rules as games/dictator/src/name.ts, and the name is kept in sessionStorage under games.name.
entities.rationale: A name typed in one game is then valid in the other.
